property_summary: For any caller and any single valid ticket payment, after play() completes the reference contract C always leaves pot either unchanged (if caller lost) or zero (if caller won and pot was paid out minus fee); the mutant that increments pot twice can leave pot larger than expected (non-zero) for some inputs, so there exists an input where C.pot() != mutated.pot().
change_summary: Insert an extra increment of pot by the ticket amount before randomness, changing eventual pot value after play.
